============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (366B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
Methodology: Full decode reads all 11 fields; mutations check city and increment/grow.
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 363 ns | 2,757,829 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 366 ns | 2,734,149 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobuf-py | 936 ns | 1,068,056 | 341 | 2.58x slower |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 436 ns | 2,293,550 | 341 | 1.20x slower |
| msgspec | 621 ns | 1,610,068 | 634 | 1.71x slower |
| msgpack | 1,667 ns | 599,703 | 634 | 4.60x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 4,766 ns | 209,809 | 874 | 13.14x slower |
